governance.title: Governance on this surface
points: Configuration, connectivity and delivery are different truth states.
Secrets are never shown; only the approved contract and runtime state are shown.
Providers that aren't available are blocked safely, and features that depend on them show this limit.
governance.note: Prototype provider names, sync times and health labels are not copied. The register, event stream and export jobs are backend reads limited to what you're allowed to see; missing tables or rows show as not available or as a checked, empty state.
